messages:
emma_support: FYI customer HelioGrid says they were charged twice for the March renewal after they attached a PO this morning. invoice_894212 and invoice_894213 both show paid. Can billing triage?

javier_billing: looking. do we have the webhook history? seems like a retry/race to me. customer says PO came at 09:12 UTC, payment at 09:13.

billingbot: Webhook delivered: event=invoice.payment_succeeded id=inv_894212 at=2026-03-15T09:13:02Z status=200
billingbot: Webhook delivered: event=invoice.created id=inv_894213 at=2026-03-15T09:13:06Z status=200

nora_finops: can you paste the raw payloads? i want to see if invoice_894213 was a duplicate created by the PO attach flow (we had a bug where PO attach created an invoice if a pending renewal existed).

emma_support: pasted payloads below. note: customer used PO net30.

```json
{
  "event": "po.attached",
  "customer": "CUST-helio",
  "po": "PO-4238",
  "attached_at": "2026-03-15T09:12:58Z"
}

{
  "event": "invoice.created",
  "invoice_id": "inv_894213",
  "origin": "po-attach",
  "amount": 1200.00,
  "status": "open"
}

{
  "event": "invoice.payment_succeeded",
  "invoice_id": "inv_894213",
  "payment_intent": "pi_7H8K",
  "paid_at": "2026-03-15T09:13:06Z"
}
```

javier_billing: OK — looks like our flow did: existing renewal invoice (inv_894212) was unpaid but TTL allowed payment to be processed (card auth triggered), then PO attach created a new invoice (inv_894213) and our payment processing kicked off again because the payment source was still present. Essentially double-charge race between renewal worker and PO-attach worker.

tim_oncall: assigning to eng to look at webhook ordering but ctl: we need immediate remediation for the customer. recommend: 1) refund the duplicate paid invoice (inv_894213) 2) create credit memo tied to inv_894213 3) confirm net effect so accounting matches. @nora_finops can you approve manual refund?

nora_finops: approve manual refund of inv_894213. also put a note to reverse any tax/VAT recorded for that invoice — HelioGrid is EU VAT-exempt so we need to adjust tax lines.

javier_billing: initiating refund: refund_id=rf_55921 created for pi_7H8K amount=1200.00 status=pending. I'll follow up once processor confirms.

emma_support: I told the customer we're refunding and flagged them for credit hold to prevent retries. customer asked for ETA — can we give ballpark?

javier_billing: bank/processor ETA 3-5 business days. I'll ping once settled.

billingbot: Payment processor update: refund rf_55921 status=successful at=2026-03-15T09:47:12Z

nora_finops: refund confirmed. created credit_memo_cm_1098 and reversed VAT lines. posting to ledger in the next batch. please note: we need an accounting adjustment for March MRR, will file internal ticket FIN-2026-34.

tim_oncall: root cause: race between renewal job and PO-attach handler. short-term mitigation: add a per-customer invoice lock on create/payment so only one active payment flow can proceed. long-term: change PO-attach to reconcile against any existing open renewal invoice instead of creating a new one.

emma_support: can eng reproduce locally? we should capture exact sequence and produce repro steps for a fix PR.

javier_billing: repro steps i used: 1) create subscription with pending renewal invoice inv_seed 2) have a valid card on file 3) trigger renewal job (simulate delay) 4) while renewal job pending, trigger PO attach webhook which calls invoice.create 5) simultaneous payment handler tries to capture card on both invoice IDs -> double capture. I can share a small script.

```bash
# simplified repro (dev env)
python simulate_renewal.py --sub sub_112 --delay 3 &
sleep 1 && curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" http://localhost:8000/webhook -d '{"event":"po.attached","customer":"sub_112","po":"PO-TEST"}'
```

tim_oncall: thanks — please attach the script in the ticket ENG-PR-402. set severity P2, candidate fix is invoice-level create lock.

emma_support: customer notified, refund completed, accounting updated. closing after engineering confirms deploy. :white_check_mark:
